title: Training record monitoring and retention need operating evidence
remediation: The training records steward establishes monitoring and retention rules for literacy and role-based training. Verify a redacted completion and overdue-training sample against the records repository. Retain evidence of authorized review, follow-up and the configured retention period, and restrict personal training data to approved holders.

milestones.title: Collect the retention rule, redacted training extracts, and a sampled overdue item and follow-up record
